meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 把 claude-mem 的观察记录按项目、类型、概念等条件筛成一份语料库，载入 AI 会话后你就能就过去的这些记录提问，追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里搭一个聚焦的知识库、就过去的工作提问，或把某主题的经验汇总起来时使用。

say.text: 帮我建一个 hooks 语料库，只收 claude-mem 项目的观察记录
say.note: 按项目筛选并生成语料库

say.text: 载入 hooks 语料库，然后告诉我 5 个生命周期钩子何时触发
say.note: 载入后可多轮追问，上下文保留

say.text: 重建 hooks 语料库，再重新载入一遍
say.note: 刷新新观察并重置会话

howto.what_en: It filters your claude-mem observations into a corpus and loads that corpus into an AI session, so you can ask questions about that past work; follow-up questions keep context.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a focused knowledge base built from your observation history, want to ask about past work patterns, or want to compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a hooks corpus from my claude-mem observations
say_en.note: Runs build_corpus with a project filter

say_en.text: Load the hooks corpus, then tell me when each lifecycle hook fires
say_en.note: Primes the corpus for multi-turn questions

say_en.text: Rebuild the hooks corpus and reprime it
say_en.note: Refreshes new observations and resets the session
